source_boundary: Derived from the five exact base-commit implementations. Qualified anisotropic forward, force balance, poloidal field recovery, dense Green, bilinear sampling and LHS are reused unchanged. No claim of entire source-project completion is made by this five-asset correction.
corrections: Explicit raw_psi versus magnetic_flux with source/observed units; only declared Wb/rad to Wb uses 2*pi. Profiles are requested point samples, not a fabricated Thomson instrument.
Every requested residual channel retains its exact shape and fixed order; missing predictions, mismatched units and nonfinite residuals reject.
Forward nonconvergence and numerical exceptions become fixed-dimensional finite invalid trials; contract exceptions propagate and invalid trials cannot be best.
Methods, finite bounds, initial values, sample designs and budget validate before science. Total calls include LHS, numerical differentiation and fresh terminal/fallback checking.
Actual optimizer terminal state is freshly verified; best valid historical trial is separately reported. Fixed budget, optimizer success, forward convergence and identifiability are distinct.

author_validation.predecessor_expected_red: 13 scientific/contract failures retained before changes; one additional intermediate regression exposed a numerical callback exception not counted as a scientific call.
author_validation.analytic_manufactured_case: Qualified anisotropic Picard + declared nonzero rank-one Green; independent quadratic field solution generates six flux/pressure observations. Recovered gradient 1.7000000000010205 and ratio 1.5999999999999683; a deliberately underiterated real trial remains invalid.
author_validation.independent_discrete_case: Independent angular Biot-Savart quadrature, cylindrical tensor divergence and nonlinear root solution generate nine curved-field observations. Qualified forward recovers gradient 4800.000000021167 and anisotropy 1099.999999993896; anisotropy changes physical J_phi.
author_validation.installed_user_runtime: No source checkout, network or captured answers; plain venv installs only exact scirel, NumPy and SciPy runtime distributions, plus pip as installer. Both physics cases and five document examples execute.

limits: The rank-one Green is a declared manufactured response, not a calibrated device geometry.

The independent curved-field oracle verifies the stated finite-grid discrete equations; it is not a continuum/grid-convergence certificate. Coincident filament self terms retain the qualified zero-self convention.

Generic parameter identifiability, global optimality, noise calibration and experimental instrument response are not established. Optimizer success alone does not establish a scientifically acceptable fit.
Caller-supplied physical closures, gauge/reference choices and pressure/field units remain part of the explicit scientific model. Raw psi is not universally magnetic flux.
Historical wrong fallback/nonconvergence expectations are preserved as predecessor evidence and replaced by correct assertions; no valid numerical tolerance was widened.
source_execution_dependencies: No original-source installation is needed for this correction; retained base source and contract evidence were used read-only.
development_dependencies: Python build backend, pytest, static document validation and independent oracle code belong to development/verification, not additional wheel requirements.
